verdict.rationale: The docs cover travel-rule handling: collecting and transmitting beneficiary information for above-threshold crypto transfers. They also document identity onboarding decisions for persons and institutions, which is KYC-adjacent. Nothing in the pack names sanctions screening or wallet risk checks, so only one of the three compliance mechanisms is specifically documented. Missing for 10: documented sanctions screening, documented wallet/address risk checks, detail on travel-rule thresholds and protocols, independent corroboration.
